question: Are the altitudes of an obtuse triangle outside the triangle? Which of the following statements is correct?
solution: The altitude to the side opposite the obtuse angle lies inside the triangle. The altitudes drawn from the two acute-angle vertices to the opposite sides (extended) lie outside the triangle.
